rawContent: @PC1963 @MamaMays123 @MTumarkin I am part of the #LivePDNation I also happen to believe #BlackLivesMatter  They are not mutually exclusive.

@OfficerHurstDPD More stories of the real need to be told. We need to separate out the fact from fiction. We need to call out bad shoots and support legit ones. However, there is no mistaking the racism that exists. I can support the #BlackLivesMatter movement AND support our LEO’s.
@PC1963 @MamaMays123 @MTumarkin There is a difference between #BlackLivesMatter movement and the group of the same name.

@MarcusGillette1 @F3JimmyDean @JDem526 @1blantdaddy That is factually inaccurate. #BlackLivesMatter is a movement. BLM is a Marxist organization. And Antifa is a whole other thing. Do not make the mistake of lumping them together. A little research will enlighten you.

@d_matuszewich @MarcusGillette1 @F3JimmyDean @JDem526 @1blantdaddy I don’t support the BLM organization. I do, however, support the #BlackLivesMatter movement. I believe in peaceful protests. I don’t condone rioting, looting, or violence no matter where it’s coming from.
